title: PortalPath
description: The Ultimate Dimensional Navigation Suite for Minecraft.
body:
# ☄️ PortalPath
**The Ultimate Dimensional Navigation Suite for Minecraft.**

PortalPath is a professional-grade, client-side utility mod designed to make traveling between dimensions seamless, accurate, and lag-free. Whether you are building complex Nether hubs, tracking distant farms, or simply trying to find your way home, PortalPath provides the tools you need with a polished, modern interface.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

* **📐 Precise Coordinate Translation:** Instantly see your target coordinates in the other dimension on a sleek, customizable HUD. Uses the exact Minecraft 8:1 ratio for 100% accuracy.
* **🔮 Portal Sync Helper:** Our unique "Ghost Box" visualization shows you exactly where you would stand in the other dimension. Build perfectly linked portals every time.
* **📍 Advanced Waypoint Management:**
  * **Pinning:** Keep your most important locations at the top of your list.
  * **Icons:** Assign verified Minecraft emojis like ❤, ★, and ☢ to your locations.
  * **Sorting:** Organize your list by Name, Distance, or Icon type.
* **🔦 High-Visibility Beacon Beams:** Render thick, "X-shaped" vertical pillars at your waypoints, visible from thousands of blocks away.
* **☠️ Automatic Smart-Saving:**
  * **Death Points:** Automatically saves your last death location with a skull icon.
  * **Spawn Tracker:** Automatically updates your waypoint whenever you set a new respawn point.
* **💬 Chat Coordinate Detection:** Click coordinates sent by friends in chat to instantly save them as a temporary waypoint.
* **⚡ Lag-Free Logic:** Optimized with a "Ticking Cache" system. Heavy calculations run only 4 times per second, ensuring your FPS stays high even on low-end devices or mobile (PojavLauncher).
* **📱 Low-End Device Ready:** Efficient object handling and render culling mean PortalPath works where other navigation mods struggle.
* **🌐 Client-Side Only:** Works on any server! Connect to Vanilla, Paper, or Spigot servers without needing the mod installed on the server side.

---

## ⚙️ Professional GUI

Press **'O'** to open the professional tabbed settings menu:
* **2-Column Grid:** Clean and compact layout for all global toggles.
* **Full Search:** Find any waypoint in seconds with the integrated search bar.
* **Individual Controls:** Toggle visibility or beacon beams for each waypoint separately.

---

## 📥 Requirements

* **Mod Loader:** Fabric Loader
* **Dependencies:** Fabric API *(Required)*
* **Game Version:** Minecraft 1.19.4
